description: 국가철도공단 수도권4호선 전동휠체어 충전설비 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 구성 - 지하철에 설치되어 있는 전동휠체어 급속 충전기의 빨간색은 전원이고 노랑색은 레버, 분홍색은 휴대폰충전 케이블이다. - 전동휠체어 급속 충전기는 좌, 우에서 동시 2대가 충전. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 9 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 휠체어, 수도권지하철4호선, 노선명, 역명. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
